title: Seiko Prospex SRPK43K King Turtle 'Night Vision' - Sapphire/Automatic $599 ($574 with Signup Bonus) Delivered @ Watch Depot
body:
Deal: Seiko Prospex SRPK43K King Turtle 'Night Vision' - Sapphire/Automatic $599 ($574 with Signup Bonus) Delivered @ Watch Depot

[skibidigrimacmoggr67] agree whatever this is looks pretty terrible for the price. watch people might say "no no it's a design from the 1960's" but idk still looks goofy.
[tonyjzx] i dont need to know the day and date that seriously
just pull out your phone
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] yes at least the ones with day number only are ok imo not too bad looking.
also apparenlty it just repeats 31 days so it's wrong and requires fixing once a month.
worth knowing I never knew this but you can't change the date between 8PM and 2AM (different time for every watch apparently) or it can permanently damage watch. could be years later and you forgget this would be much safer for a watch without any date info.
[tonyjzx] @skibidigrimacmoggr67: yeah the only watch i reguarly use is an auto chrono w/ day date and its a PAIN setting the day and date correctly
i do it when i'm watiing at the RTA and got nothing else to do
i rarely even set the date any more
i think i could do with a sub no date at this point… sorta like the ozbb incel mantra "no dates"
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] @tonyjzx:
yeah the only watch i reguarly use is an auto chrono w/ day date and its a PAIN setting the day and date correctly
yeah idk second time I mentioned this date damage risk and someone disagrees. but because it's true. is there some $3000 watch out there where you can't damage the watch? probably but what I'm saying is correct.
I posted a $400 watch recently and it might be laughing price for some people but to me it's unaffordable. I imagined opening the $400 watch and damaging the date straight away not knowing about this issue. that would suck.
ozbb incel mantra "no dates"
huh?? never heard this before what. 😂
[Nom] @skibidigrimacmoggr67: You can't adjust the date when it's close to changing because you can damage the sensitive mechanism.
The manual will explicitly point this out, it's a pretty standard watch thing.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] @Nom:
it's a pretty standard watch thing.
yes but for me a few days ago it was a TIL. I prefer digital watch btw where this isn't even a thing.
[boozed] Day is less useful than date but I wear a watch so that I don't have to pull out my phone. That the watch cost more than the phone is neither here nor there…
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] @boozed: the correct method is to keep your phone in your hand at all times . this way you don't leave it behind, it can't get nicked from you and it's just as fast to check date. 😂
[MS Paint] Nothing a jet lighter and 20 seconds can't fix
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] Nothing a jet lighter
I think you meant jet f ighter
